messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Nov 02, 2021, Shiho Ohno wrote:
>
>I'm currently in the process of installing Amber Tool 19.
>. /configure gnu and got the following error
I have never seen this error before. What OS and compiler are you using?
It's certainly worth downloading AmberTools21, and using cmake to build the
system. But you may get the same error, since it doesn't look like it is
related to the build process.
>Checking NetCDF...
>config.status: executing depfiles commands
>config.status: error: in `/home/user/amber18/AmberTools/src/netcdf-4.6.1':
>config.status: error: Something went wrong bootstrapping makefile fragments
> for automatic dependency tracking. Try re-running configure with the
> '--disable-dependency-tracking' option to at least be able to build
> the package (albeit without support for automatic dependency tracking).
>
>See `config.log' for more details
>
....dac
